test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 27 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Red letter day
solution:
The correct answer is '**a day that is pleasantly noteworthy or memorable.**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• 'Red letter day' is an idiom that means **a day that is pleasantly noteworthy or memorable.**

 
 
• *Example:* *The day I first set foot in America was **a red-letter day **for me.*
 
 
 
• From the given options, only option 1 fits the meaning.

Thus, the correct answer is option 1.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Rose day - Refers to a day celebrated in some cultures where people exchange roses, often associated with Valentine's Day.
 
• Holiday - A day of festivity or recreation when no work is done.
 
• Birthday - The anniversary of the day on which a person was born.
